original_target.title: The sharp support–concentration bound for subset sums
original_target.area: Combinatorial probability, information theory and packing algorithms

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
queries: "subset sums" "support" "concentration" site:zenodo.org OR site:hal.science OR site:github.com

sources.scope: Retains H0<=2 H-infinity; support-entropy coefficient depends on input and positive-order constants deteriorate toward order zero.

registry_checks: Palomar no subset-sums match. Hexagon 2610.00599 is lower support size for zero-sum-free sets in finite groups; unrelated worst-case decision algorithms also routed, not accepted as full candidates. Current arXiv, Zenodo, HAL and GitHub searches.
scope_comparison: Need N(w)rho(w)²<=1 exactly for arbitrary repeated, zero, negative real weights with fair independent bits. Input-dependent entropy comparisons, finite-group set bounds and faster decision algorithms do not prove this exact support/atom relation.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement. Primary current paper retains the exact target as a conjecture.
